summary: Alset Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a securities purchase agreement with related party DSS Inc. Alset loaned $1 million to DSS in exchange for a convertible promissory note bearing 3% simple interest, convertible at $0.45 per share, and warrants to purchase up to 17,777,776 shares at $0.50 per share. The transaction is a related-party loan, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report of a material definitive agreement. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. This is a financing arrangement between entities under common control, subject to stockholder approval. No special-situation category applies.
